task.title: Reset MFA for a locked-out user
task.shortdesc: For the IT service desk. Takes about five minutes.

ul.li: Confirm that the request is genuine. Call the user on the number in the HR system, not the number in the ticket.
Contractor accounts follow a different process. Send those requests to the IAM team.

step.cmd: In Acme Console, open the user's profile.

info.note: Don't select Reset password. It leaves the old device enrolled.

step.cmd: Ask the user to open the enrollment email and register the new device.

result.p: The system log shows a new enrollment for the user.

p.b: If the user has no second device

ol.li: In Acme Console, go to Security > Recovery codes.
Select Generate, and then read the code to the user by phone.
